name: Prince Motoyoshi
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 20); Porter’s note gives the dates as: d. 943.

poems.title: We met but for a moment, and
poems.author: Prince Motoyoshi
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 20
poems.text:
We met but for a moment, and
I’m wretched as before;
The tide shall measure out my life,
Unless I see once more
The maid, whom I adore.
